bioconda.name: r-tidytacos
bioconda.summary: Functions to manipulate and visualize microbial community data
bioconda.description: Tidytacos (tidy TAxonomic COmpositionS) is an R package for the exploration of microbial community data. Such community data consists of read counts generated by amplicon sequencing (e.g. a region of the 16S rRNA gene) or metagenome (shotgun) sequencing. Each read count represents a number of sequencing reads identified for some taxon (an ASV, OTU, species, or higher-level taxon) in a sample.
